name: b-raid-gaps
note: Living Server 1.2 raid AI, pass 3 (2026-11-15): every page that docs/research/raid-sources/wayback-gaps.md and wayback-pass2.md list as reachable only on the Wayback Machine (the cloud session's WebFetch and shell both are refused web.archive.org). Priority bosses: Caer Sidi, Tuscaran Glacier, Galladoria, Summoner's Hall, Krondon, Darkness Falls, Trollheim, the dragons. Herald articles (The Death of a Dragon, more/226, and the Grab Bags) are not repeated here: 9-herald-articles covers every /more/ id. Raw pages stay on the PC; facts go into our own words in docs/research/raid-sources/.
